hero.title: Publishing Knowledge, <break/><highlight>Building a Scholarly Legacy.</highlight>
hero.description: PT Cakrawala Magna Scientia is an Indonesian knowledge enterprise that develops a technology-driven ecosystem for publishing, rights management, learning, and intellectual asset development through CakraNexa.
hero.subdescription: We exist to build a sustainable knowledge lifecycle—from idea acquisition and publishing to copyright protection and adaptation across generations.

differentiator.title: Managing Works as a Long-Term Portfolio
differentiator.description: We believe the value of knowledge keeps growing when it is managed with integrity, technology, and sound governance.
differentiator.highlight: Through CakraNexa, a work does not end as a printed book—it continues to evolve into e-books, audiobooks, training modules, toolkits, institutional licenses, and integrated databases.

scope.title: Scope of Activities
scope.description: CakraNexa's six operational pillars supporting the dissemination and monetization of academic and professional intellectual works.

publishing.title: Publishing & Digital Publication
publishing.description: Manuscript acquisition, editorial, design, bibliographic metadata, print publication, e-books, and catalogue management.

academy.title: Education & Training (Academy)
academy.description: Development of courses, workshops, training, and learning programs grounded in the expertise of practitioners and academics.

rights.title: Rights & IP Licensing
rights.description: Management of translation, audio, and adaptation rights, library licensing, and the lawful use of works.

institutional.title: Institutional Solutions
institutional.description: Strategic partnerships with educational institutions, professional associations, companies, and libraries.

technology.title: Knowledge Technology
technology.description: Responsible application of structured data, discoverability, analytics, and artificial intelligence (AI).

authorDevelopment.title: Author Development
authorDevelopment.description: Long-term mentoring and collaboration with authors to advance their scholarly careers.

lifecycle.title: The Lifecycle of a Work
lifecycle.description: A measured, circular workflow ensuring that every work does not stop at printing, but continues to be nurtured and to grow in value.
lifecycle.summary: CakraNexa nurtures published works through metadata updates, revised editions, new licenses, and a readership that expands across generations.

copyright.title: Respect for Copyright (IP)
copyright.description: Every use of a work—for translation, digitization, or AI technology—is carried out transparently under valid legal agreements.

editorial.title: Editorial Integrity
editorial.description: We place emphasis on originality, writing ethics, and reference verification to uphold academic and professional publishing standards.

continuity.title: Institutional Continuity
continuity.description: Documentation, source files, metadata, and contracts are managed centrally as institutional assets, ensuring that works remain available for the long term.

header.title: Publishing Knowledge, Building a Legacy
header.description: PT Cakrawala Magna Scientia is building a knowledge ecosystem that goes beyond publishing. We manage knowledge throughout its lifecycle—from idea, publication, learning, renewal, and rights protection to cross-format development and its handing down to future generations.

statement.title: Our Vision
statement.text: To be a world-class Indonesian knowledge enterprise that builds an intellectual legacy across generations by making every work a knowledge asset that can be discovered, trusted, studied, updated, protected, developed, licensed, and passed on sustainably.

missions.title: Mission
missions.description: The operational steps we consistently take to realize CakraNexa's scholarly vision.

items.title: Quality Publishing
items.description: Publishing works that are high-quality, credible, relevant, and impactful through professional and accountable selection, editing, production, publication, and quality assurance processes.

items.title: Knowledge That Stays Alive
items.description: Updating the substance, data, references, metadata, design, and format of works so that knowledge remains relevant as times change and for the next generation of readers.

items.title: Multiformat Development
items.description: Developing every work into a multiformat knowledge portfolio that may include print books, e-books, audiobooks, courses, toolkits, databases, translations, adaptations, and institutional and technology licenses.

items.title: Access and Discoverability
items.description: Expanding the visibility and reach of works and authors through quality metadata, structured data, search systems, categories, series, editorial content, semantic search, and recommendation technology.

items.title: An Ecosystem of Authors, Readers, and Institutions
items.description: Building long-term relationships with authors, readers, professionals, academics, libraries, educational institutions, corporations, resellers, and strategic partners.

items.title: Protecting Intellectual Assets
items.description: Responsibly protecting and managing copyright, publishing rights, translation, audio, and adaptation rights, digital licenses, AI licenses, contracts, provenance, metadata, source files, and other intellectual assets.

items.title: Technology and Data
items.description: Using technology, data, analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence responsibly to improve quality, efficiency, access, decision-making, and the company's long-term sustainability.

items.title: Governance and Succession
items.description: Building governance, documentation, systems, leadership succession, and talent development so that the company can grow across generations without depending on any single individual, vendor, platform, or technology.

values.title: The Values That Guide Us
values.description: The principles behind every CakraNexa decision, work, partnership, and innovation.

items.name: Intellectual Integrity
items.description: Upholding accuracy, academic honesty, transparency of sources, respect for copyright, and responsibility to our readers.

items.name: Excellence
items.description: Setting high standards in editorial work, design, production, technology, marketing, author services, and the reader experience.

items.name: Knowledge Sustainability
items.description: Treating every work as an intellectual asset that can continually be updated, developed, licensed, and passed on.

items.name: Accessibility & Visibility
items.description: Making quality knowledge ever easier to discover, access, understand, and use.

items.name: Collaboration
items.description: Building fair, productive, long-term relationships with all stakeholders in the knowledge ecosystem.

items.name: Responsible Innovation
items.description: Using technology, data, automation, and AI to strengthen quality and access without compromising the integrity of the work.

items.name: Governance & Accountability
items.description: Ensuring that key processes are documented, measurable, auditable, and carried out under clear lines of authority and responsibility.

items.name: Succession
items.description: Ensuring that the company's knowledge, competencies, leadership, and systems can be handed on to the next generation.

pillars.title: CakraNexa's Strategic Pillars
pillars.description: Six operational pillars that sustain the ecosystem's longevity and excellence.

publishing.title: Publishing Excellence
publishing.description: Building a professional publishing process—from manuscript acquisition, editorial, design, production, and distribution to evaluating the performance of every title.

lifecycle.title: Knowledge Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Managing works throughout their lifecycle: published, marketed, updated, reformatted, translated, taught, and licensed.

discoverability.title: Discoverability & Commerce
discoverability.description: Ensuring works can be found and obtained through metadata, search, structured data, categories, series, editorial content, and integrated sales channels.

community.title: Community & Learning
community.description: Building lasting relationships with readers, authors, professionals, academics, institutions, and libraries through community and learning.

rights.title: Rights & Intellectual Assets
rights.description: Managing rights, contracts, provenance, backlist, metadata, source files, translations, audio, adaptations, and licenses as long-term assets.

continuity.title: Institutional Continuity
continuity.description: Building systems, documentation, succession planning, data, governance, security, and diversified revenue so that the company can thrive across generations.

manifesto.title: Knowledge Is More Than a Product
manifesto.text: PT Cakrawala Magna Scientia sees every work not as a one-time product, but as a long-term knowledge asset. A book can keep growing into new editions, e-books, audiobooks, courses, toolkits, databases, translations, institutional licenses, adaptations, and other forms of knowledge use. That is why we build systems that safeguard not only the published work, but also the metadata, contracts, provenance, source files, intellectual property rights, author relationships, and institutional knowledge that come with it.

collaboration.title: Building a Knowledge Legacy Together
collaboration.text: PT Cakrawala Magna Scientia welcomes collaboration with authors, academics, professionals, institutions, libraries, and partners who share our commitment to creating and passing on meaningful knowledge.

organization.title: Organizational Structure
organization.caption: Official Governance and Management Chart of PT Cakrawala Magna Scientia

commissioner.description: Performs general oversight, reviews budget compliance, and ensures that the company consistently applies the principles of Good Corporate Governance.

director.description: Leads the implementation of the vision, sets the operational and commercial direction, and coordinates all management lines across the CakraNexa publishing ecosystem.

expertBoard.description: An independent advisory body that provides counsel on scientific substance, publication ethics, the soundness of research methodology, and strengthening the quality of published monographs.

generalHr.description: Manages talent development, corporate legal administration, external institutional relations, and office facilities and infrastructure.

finance.description: Manages budget planning, cash flow, transparent author royalties, tax compliance, and accountable financial reporting for the company.

it.description: Develops CakraNexa's digital platform infrastructure, semantic search architecture, structured metadata management, and the company's data security.

publishing.description: Oversees the manuscript publishing cycle, the editorial process, substantive peer review, scholarly quality assurance, Perpusnas ISBN administration, and copyright governance.

printing.description: Manages prepress operations, physical printing, binding and paper quality assurance, and the warehousing, logistics, and shipping of books in a measured, well-controlled way.
